task: 2021 ve 2022 takvim yıllarını karşılaştır: her yıl için toplam ciro (TL), sipariş (fiş) sayısı ve ortalama sepet tutarı (ciro / sipariş sayısı). 2021'den 2022'ye her birinin yüzde değişimini hesapla ve ciro değişiminin ağırlıklı olarak sipariş sayısından mı yoksa sepet tutarından mı kaynaklandığını sayılarla açıkla.

Her ana kategori (category1) için 2021 ve 2022 takvim yıllarında gerçekleşen ortalama birim fiyatı hesapla (yıl içindeki toplam ciro / toplam satış adedi). 2021'den 2022'ye birim fiyatın en çok arttığı 3 ana kategoriyi, her birinin 2021 ve 2022 birim fiyatı ve yüzde artışıyla ver. Tüm kategorilerin ortalama artışını da belirt.

input.sql:
WITH y AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)::int AS yil,
         SUM(revenue) AS ciro,
         SUM(order_count) AS siparis
  FROM daily_branch_sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2021-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2023-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT yil, ROUND(ciro,2) AS ciro, siparis, ROUND(ciro/siparis,2) AS ort_sepet,
       ROUND(LN(ciro),6) AS ln_ciro, ROUND(LN(siparis),6) AS ln_siparis, ROUND(LN(ciro/siparis),6) AS ln_sepet
FROM y ORDER BY yil

WITH y AS (
  SELECT i.category1,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.month)::int AS yil,
         SUM(m.revenue) AS ciro,
         SUM(m.quantity) AS adet
  FROM monthly_item_sales m
  JOIN items i ON i.item_id = m.item_id
  WHERE m.month >= DATE '2021-01-01' AND m.month < DATE '2023-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), p AS (
  SELECT category1,
         MAX(CASE WHEN yil = 2021 THEN ciro / NULLIF(adet, 0) END) AS bf_2021,
         MAX(CASE WHEN yil = 2022 THEN ciro / NULLIF(adet, 0) END) AS bf_2022
  FROM y GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT category1,
       ROUND(bf_2021, 2) AS birim_fiyat_2021,
       ROUND(bf_2022, 2) AS birim_fiyat_2022,
       ROUND(100.0 * (bf_2022 / bf_2021 - 1), 2) AS artis_yuzde
FROM p
ORDER BY artis_yuzde DESC

WITH y AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)::int AS yil,
         SUM(revenue) AS ciro, SUM(order_count) AS siparis
  FROM daily_branch_sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2021-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2023-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
), p AS (
  SELECT MAX(ciro) FILTER (WHERE yil=2021) c1, MAX(ciro) FILTER (WHERE yil=2022) c2,
         MAX(siparis) FILTER (WHERE yil=2021) s1, MAX(siparis) FILTER (WHERE yil=2022) s2
  FROM y
)
SELECT ROUND(100*(c2/c1-1),2) AS ciro_degisim_yuzde,
       ROUND(100*(s2::numeric/s1-1),2) AS siparis_degisim_yuzde,
       ROUND(100*((c2/s2)/(c1/s1)-1),2) AS sepet_degisim_yuzde,
       ROUND(c2-c1,2) AS ciro_fark_tl,
       ROUND((s2-s1)*(c1/s1),2) AS siparis_etkisi_tl,
       ROUND(s2*((c2/s2)-(c1/s1)),2) AS sepet_etkisi_tl,
       ROUND(100*LN(s2::numeric/s1)/LN(c2/c1),2) AS siparis_payi_log_yuzde,
       ROUND(100*LN((c2/s2)/(c1/s1))/LN(c2/c1),2) AS sepet_payi_log_yuzde
FROM p

input.sql:
WITH y AS (
  SELECT i.category1,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.month)::int AS yil,
         SUM(m.revenue) AS ciro,
         SUM(m.quantity) AS adet
  FROM monthly_item_sales m
  JOIN items i ON i.item_id = m.item_id
  WHERE m.month >= DATE '2021-01-01' AND m.month < DATE '2023-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), p AS (
  SELECT category1,
         MAX(CASE WHEN yil = 2021 THEN ciro / NULLIF(adet, 0) END) AS bf_2021,
         MAX(CASE WHEN yil = 2022 THEN ciro / NULLIF(adet, 0) END) AS bf_2022
  FROM y GROUP BY 1
), tot AS (
  SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN yil = 2021 THEN ciro END) / SUM(CASE WHEN yil = 2021 THEN adet END) AS t21,
         SUM(CASE WHEN yil = 2022 THEN ciro END) / SUM(CASE WHEN yil = 2022 THEN adet END) AS t22
  FROM y
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS kategori_sayisi,
       ROUND(AVG(100.0 * (bf_2022 / bf_2021 - 1)), 2) AS basit_ort_artis_yuzde,
       ROUND(MIN(100.0 * (bf_2022 / bf_2021 - 1)), 2) AS min_artis,
       ROUND(MAX(100.0 * (bf_2022 / bf_2021 - 1)), 2) AS max_artis,
       (SELECT ROUND(t21, 2) FROM tot) AS genel_bf_2021,
       (SELECT ROUND(t22, 2) FROM tot) AS genel_bf_2022,
       (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (t22 / t21 - 1), 2) FROM tot) AS genel_agirlikli_artis_yuzde,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM monthly_item_sales m LEFT JOIN items i ON i.item_id = m.item_id
         WHERE i.item_id IS NULL OR i.category1 IS NULL) AS eslesmeyen_satir
FROM p
